brief: Today's UPSC Intelligence Briefing covering key developments in International Relations, Deep-Sea Ecology, Quantum Infrastructure, Urban Disaster Governance, and Bio-Economy Governance.

articles.title: Global South Clean Energy Alliance (GSCEA) Framework Ratified at New Delhi Summit
articles.summary: Developing nations adopt a unified strategy for technology transfer and concessional climate finance ahead of COP31.
prelims: GSCEA was proposed as an outcome of India's voice of the Global South initiatives.
Establishes a $50 billion concessional fund managed by the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank (AIIB).
Focuses on decentralised renewable grids and critical mineral processing capability in developing nations.
articles.mains: Evaluates how India leverages South-South Cooperation to reshape global climate diplomacy and challenge traditional North-South financial impasses.

articles.title: International Seabed Authority (ISA) Issues Revised Guidelines for Deep Seabed Mining
articles.summary: New regulatory framework mandates strict environmental impact assessments and real-time biodiversity monitoring for polymetallic nodule extraction.
prelims: India's Deep Ocean Mission is operated under the Ministry of Earth Sciences (MoES).
Polymetallic nodules in the Central Indian Ocean Basin contain copper, nickel, cobalt, and manganese.
ISA is an autonomous international organization established under the 1982 UN Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS).
articles.mains: Discuss the tension between technological resource acquisition for green energy transitions and marine ecosystem preservation in international waters.

articles.title: Cabinet Approves National Quantum Communication Backbone Project
articles.summary: India launches a multi-city Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) network to secure critical strategic and financial digital infrastructure.
prelims: Implemented under the National Quantum Mission (NQM) launched by the Department of Science & Technology.
Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) leverages quantum mechanics principles like superposition and entanglement for encryption.
Phase 1 connects national capital hubs, defense nodes, and reserve banking servers via satellite and fiber QKD.
articles.mains: Analyze the strategic imperative of post-quantum cryptography for national security in an era of asymmetric cyber warfare.

articles.title: MoHUA Releases Sponge Cities Governance Guidelines 2026 for Coastal Urban Agglomerations
articles.summary: A nationwide mandate integrating nature-based drainage solutions into urban master plans to mitigate flash flooding.
prelims: Sponge Cities design uses permeable pavements, urban wetlands, bioswales, and rain gardens to absorb run-off.
Integrated into AMRUT 2.0 and the National Disaster Management Authority (NDMA) urban flood framework.
Focuses on coastal cities vulnerable to compound flooding from extreme rainfall and storm surges.
articles.mains: Critically analyze why traditional concrete storm-water infrastructure fails against climate-induced extreme events and how eco-hydrological planning provides urban resilience.

articles.title: Bio-E3 Policy 2.0: Operational Guidelines for Synthetic Biology & Biomanufacturing Hubs
articles.summary: Government releases regulatory mechanisms for bio-foundries, biomanufacturing hubs, and biosafety protocols for gene-edited organisms.
prelims: Bio-E3 stands for Biotechnology for Economy, Environment, and Employment.
Monitored by the Department of Biotechnology (DBT) under the Ministry of Science and Technology.
Facilitates transition from fossil-fuel-based chemicals to bio-based polymers, bio-enzymes, and smart proteins.
articles.mains: Examine the role of biomanufacturing in achieving India's target of a $300 billion bioeconomy while maintaining ethical and biosafety standards.
